record.question: Which continent has the heaviest burden of HIV/AIDS?
record.explanation: Answer C: Africa. Sub-Saharan Africa bears the largest share of people living with HIV globally. Reference: https://www.unaids.org/en/resources/fact-sheet. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: General Studies Paper-II, January 2026 examination; current affairs are interpreted as of the paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
